gaps.sentence: So rapid ___ the spread of the fire that the building was lost.
gaps.explanation: 'So rapid was the spread that …' — fronted 'so + adj' with inversion.

gaps.sentence: Only later ___ it occur to her that the letter had been a forgery.
gaps.explanation: 'Only later' at the front inverts with do-support: did it occur to her.

gaps.sentence: Only when the audit was complete ___ the accounts released.

gaps.sentence: Only after the interview ___ I realise how nervous I had been.

gaps.sentence: ___ as it may sound, the machine still works perfectly.
gaps.explanation: Adjective + as + subject + verb = although it sounds strange.

gaps.sentence: Only now ___ the true cost of the delay becoming clear.
gaps.explanation: 'Only now' + the progressive 'becoming' forces 'is' with inversion.

gaps.sentence: To such extremes ___ the fans go that the police were called in.

gaps.sentence: No sooner ___ the contract been signed than the rumours started.
